# Levente Otta

> Levente Otta (Otisz) is a Senior Fullstack Developer in Budapest, Hungary, building CRM, ERP and SaaS platforms with Laravel, NestJS and React since 2017. He currently works at Bit Different Ltd. on myPlan.cloud, a construction project management platform.
